translations.web: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
translations.bsb: He who despises instruction will pay the penalty, but the one who respects a command will be rewarded.
translations.kjv: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
translations.asv: Whoso despiseth the word bringeth destruction on himself; But he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
